title: Photographs: Fate Marable boat band, Zurich poster, Louis Russell band, Ralph Sutton
summary: Looking through Foster's photos and posters from the boat band, the 1951 Zurich date, the Louis Russell band and recording sessions in New York.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
